quote: Whenever signals are placed over the individual lanes of a highway, the signals indicate, and apply to drivers of vehicles, as follows: A red “X” symbol means a driver facing the signal must not enter or drive in any lane over which the red signal is shown.

activation.condition: An overhead signal applies to the individual highway lane and faces the bus driver.

obligation.description: Under a red X, the facing driver must not enter or drive in the governed lane.

timing.description: Entry and in-lane driving are observed while red X is shown.

parameter_refs.name: overhead_red_x_setup
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed bus-facing overhead red X and governed lane

parameter_refs.name: bus_route_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: adjacent travel, lateral entry, governed-lane hold or travel
